paragraphs.text: A desktop notification and a sound when the agent finishes, asks a question, or needs your approval
— with your own sounds.
# dsh-plugin-agent-alerts
A desktop notification and a sound the moment the agent **finishes a turn**, **asks you a question**
, or **needs your approval** — so you can go and do something else instead of watching the window.
> dsh-plugin-agent-alerts — agent 回复完、向你提问、或需要你批准工具时，弹出桌面通知并播放提示音
中文说明（点开） —— 你不用一直盯着窗口，它响了再回来
**它是什么**：给 DSH 加上**提示音 + macOS 桌面通知**。三种时刻会响：agent 把一轮做完了、agent 向你提问、工具在等你批准。
**为什么做**：agent 跑一个 turn 可能要几分钟，这期间正确的做法是去干别的 —— 但"去干别的"需要一个信号把你叫回来，DSH 本身没有。
**自带两段哆啦A梦音效**，也可以换成你自己的文件（设置里填绝对路径，页面上会显示它有没有读到）。
**通知有两种通道**，因为可靠性不一样：
| 方式 | 说明 |

| **应用横幅**（默认） | Harness 自己的名字和图标，**点一下会跳到那个会话** |
| **系统兜底** | 让 macOS 代为通知，署名是「脚本编辑器」，点了没反应 —— 横幅一

*（默认） | Harness 自己的名字和图标，**点一下会跳到那个会话** |
| **系统兜底** | 让 macOS 代为通知，署名是「脚本编辑器」，点了没反应 —— 横幅一直不出来时用它 |
**三件它故意不做的事**：
- **子 agent 的 turn 结束不响。** 一次 workflow 一分钟能结束几十个子运行，每个都响就是在训练你忽略它。但**子 agent 提问或要审批照常响** —— 那仍然是你的决定

。
- **页面刚加载不补报历史。** app 在会话列表加载时会把所有历史空闲会话标成"未读"，把它们当新闻就会每次开 app 响几十下。
[该节后续省略]
## Why
An agent turn takes minutes. The rational thing to do is leave — and the whole point of leaving is t
hat you need a signal to come back. DSH does not have one.
Two cues rather than one, because they fail differently: the **sound** reaches you when the window i
s behind three others, and the **banner** tells you *which* session and opens it on click.
## What it alerts on
| Moment | Sound | Notification |

| A turn finished | `duo_finish.mp3` | The session's title |
| The agent asked you a question | `duo

_question.mp3` | The question text |
| A tool needs your approval | `duo_question.mp3` | The tool th

at is asking |
| A plan is waiting for review | `duo_question.mp3` | The plan prompt |
Click a banner to bring the window forward and open the session it was about. The settings page stat
es whether that click is wired, so a silent failure is visible rather than invisible. The **system f
allback is not clickable** — `display notification` carries no action — which is part of why it is o
k is not clickable** — `display notification` carries no action — which is part of why it is opt-in.
Three things it deliberately does **not** do:
- **It does not announce a child agent's turn.** A workflow can finish dozens of subagent runs in a
minute; announcing each one teaches you to ignore the alert. Questions and approvals from a child st

ill ring, because those are still your decision.
- **It does not replay history when the page loads.
** The app marks every historically idle session as unread while its list loads; treating that as ne

ws would fire one alert per old session on every launch.
- **It does not announce a turn that immedi
ately resumes.** A goal round closes its turn and opens the next one a moment later, so a finished t
urn is held for 1.5 seconds and dropped if the session is running again — or if the reason it closed
is that the agent is waiting on you.
## Install
Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.
| Field | Value |

| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-agent-alerts#v0.3.4` |
| Local directory | an absolute p
ath, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-agent-alerts` |
Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half is only loaded at startup. The browser half reload
top app afterwards: the Host half is only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page.
> If **Add plugin** reports `connection to github.com timed out after 5000ms`, that is the manager's
own connectivity preflight (a 5-second `git` check) rather than the download — the same tarball fet
ches in under a second, and a plain `https://codeload.github.com/...` GET succeeds while `git ls-rem
ote` over HTTPS hangs. Retry it, or install the same spec with `pnpm add` in your profile directory.
This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install path.
## Settings
**Settings → Plugins → Agent Alerts → the row's configure control.** Every switch applies immediatel
y; nothing needs a restart.
| Setting | Default | Notes |

| A turn finished | on | |
[该节后续省略]
## What it does not reach

- **No sound packs and no file picker.** A custom sound is an absolute path you type.
- **Nothing su

rvives the app quitting.** No daemon, no background process.
- **No per-session or per-workspace rul

es.** The switches are global.
- **The system fallback is macOS-only.** On other platforms the route
answers `501` rather than going quiet.
## Compatibility
Re-checked against **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** on macOS (Apple Silicon), in a real profile: the browser half
mounts, its settings page is seated on this plugin's row, and every contract below still resolves. T
he by-hand end-to-end pass (sound, notification, the test button) was on 0.2.0-rc.2 — `docs/plan.md`
records what that measurement got wrong.
| Contract | Where it comes from |
| `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` — one observable map of `{ running, pendingInteraction, completionUn

read }` | `dsh-client-ui-session` |
| `ctx.configForms`, and the `plugins.row.config` seat keyed `<p

ackage>#<rowId>` | `dsh-client-ui-settings`, `dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager` |
| A `webServer` route
reachable from the `dsh-app://app` page, behind `connection.admit` | `dsh-host-webserver`, `dsh-api-

remotes` |
| `ctx.remote.$on('user-questions/request')` as a waterfall | `dsh-api-gateway` |
The notification path is the fragile one, because the page cannot observe whether the operating syst
em displayed anything: `Notification.permission` reports `granted` from Electron's own gate, not mac
OS's. That is why there are two transports and a test button.
